description: For learners starting a new stage, course or unit whose tasks assume earlier capabilities, checking each learner's starting response on those capabilities and adjusting the entry point, support and setting to it is expected to let more of them reach the stage's goals than holding them back until judged ready or teaching all from one assumed starting point; no claim in the wiki tests this directly, though claims on delayed entry, repetition and preschool attendance bear on it.
title: Educational Readiness
